# npm-hosted (npm hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## npm configuration — .npmrc
registry=http://gateway.test/gw/npm/npm-hosted/
//gateway.test/gw/npm/npm-hosted/:_authToken=${ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}
always-auth=true

## publish
npm publish --registry http://gateway.test/gw/npm/npm-hosted/
